data.exact_reserve_text: This transaction resulted in the transfer to Syndicate 3500 of gross and net technical provisions of $252.1 million and $169.0 million, respectively.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer into Syndicate 3500 of gross and net technical provisions from other syndicates (reinsurance to close) during the year

data.standardized_narrative: The report documents transfers of technical provisions into Syndicate 3500 (reinsurance to close) during the year; however the audited financial statements and notes do not present a clearly extractable single gross prior-year reserve movement figure. RITC transactions materially affected the technical provisions and make direct computation of a consolidated gross prior year reserve movement from the available tables unreliable. Detailed gross 'movement in prior year provision' figures were not unambiguously located.
raw_causal_phrases: This transaction resulted in the transfer to Syndicate 3500 of gross and net technical provisions of $252.1 million and $169.0 million, respectively.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images are partially legible. Key required figures (gross claims outstanding at the opening/prior year and a gross movement in prior year provision) could not be unambiguously located in the balance sheet/technical reserves notes from the provided images. There are clear reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transactions disclosed (quantified transfers of gross and net technical provisions) which distort claims development tables; this further impedes reliable extraction of a single gross prior-year development figure. Where a gross movement was not found, no net fallback was extracted. Many numeric tables are present but not reliably OCR'd; users should consult original PDF for precise amounts.
